tools.name: carry_verdicts
tools.description: Read-only Hyperliquid funding verdicts for tracked markets, with basis and 24h sample context. Positions, trades, and returns are not verified. Costs $0.10/call via x402.

tools.name: carry_opportunities
tools.description: Full-universe Hyperliquid carry scan: every positive-funding perp ranked by spot-hedgeability (real HL spot pair + $10k/day volume). Costs $0.50/call via x402.

tools.name: carry_digest
tools.description: Latest daily settled-prints funding digest (markdown) from the public track record. Costs $0.02/call via x402. An older dated sample is free at /carry/digest/free when available.

tools.name: carry_free_sample
tools.description: FREE (no payment): previous published funding digest when available, with exact sample and latest-report dates. Use this to verify data quality before paying.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "carry_verdicts" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
